about: Every source here must be free to redistribute. Add a source only with its license. Items with needsReview=true are skipped unless --include-review is passed.

packs.title: Small
packs.summary: The essentials: first aid, safe water, fire, shelter and a basic kit. Fits on any phone.

packs.title: Medium
packs.summary: Small, plus living off-grid for the long haul: growing and preserving food, renewable water, sanitation, power, radios, and Army and FEMA manuals.

packs.title: Large
packs.summary: Everything we have: more no-power, no-gadget guides for growing and keeping food, water, shelter, hand tools and repairs, plus extra field manuals.
